_note: Decision document (capability C03, decision 182). A case type configures, per kind of decision it issues, what the decision needs: template, required fields, validity rules (OpenRegister named conditions), remedy clause, whether it is signed, the delegated-authority act that decides it, the decidiq decision kind, the number series and the statuses from which it is frozen. Read by DecisionDocumentDefinition. Kept apart from decisionTypes, which holds the ZGW besluittype references as strings. Declared on caseType because OpenRegister's magic mapper stores no undeclared key.

decisionDocuments.title: Decisions
decisionDocuments.description: Per kind of decision this case type issues: what it must contain, who decides it, and how it is numbered and signed.

template.title: Template
template.description: The template the decision is written from.

requiredFields.title: Required fields
requiredFields.description: Fields that must be filled before the decision can be approved.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: Conditions the decision must meet before it can be approved.

when.title: Condition

conditions.title: Named conditions
conditions.description: Named conditions the rules can refer to.

remedyClause.title: How to object
